pieces.Text: As a standard action, a sleipnir can exhale a 30- foot cone of shimmering, rainbowcolored light. Every creature in the area is randomly struck by one or more beams, as a prismatic spray spell (DC 22 half or negates). The sleipnir may use this ability once every 1d6 rounds, up to 3 times per day. The save DC is Constitution-based.
